title: High order ghost-FEM for incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on moving domains
summary: We develop a new numerical technique for approximating solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations on moving domains. The method aims at simulating an incompressible fluid past an object whose motion is assigned a priori using a level-set function. The proposed approach relies on a space discretization based on the ghost finite element method (ghost-FEM), which allows computations on unfitted meshes and avoids costly remeshing as the domain evolves in time.
